title: del.in~

messages.description: signal input(s) into the delay line

arguments.description: delay name (optional: default internal name relative to patch)
delay size in ms or samples

flags.name: -samps
flags.description: sets time value to samples (default is ms)

body: [del.in~] sets and writes to a delay line. Use [del.out~] to read it. This is quite similar to [delread~]/[delread4~], but with more features. Its delay size also sets the maximum delay time of a matching [del.out~].
